note: Second-wave authored-motion program. Group A adds clips on already-sealed banks; Group B adds new MOTION_* rigs to high-visibility models. Every job requires: Blender action(s) in tools/blender/forge/animations/, motion-bank rebuild + reseal, authoredMotion.js event wiring, focused tests, and a render-check against intent.

jobs.title: Kestrel landing struts deploy + dock settle
jobs.rationale: Docking is the most repeated event in the game; the hull currently teleports to 'docked' with zero body language.

jobs.title: Kestrel canopy + pod hatch service cycle
jobs.rationale: Service events are invisible; the pod hatch pivot already exists, canopy is one new pivot.

jobs.title: Kestrel damage flinch — armor cap pop + dish recoil
jobs.rationale: Armor-cap and dish pivots exist; a quick authored flinch sells impact far better than camera shake alone.

jobs.title: Jump-ring idle roll + charge surge
jobs.rationale: 12 emitter pivots already banked; the ring is the game's signature set piece and should never sit still.

jobs.title: Fab crane work-idle sway
jobs.rationale: Crane/hoist/arm pivots exist; ambient micro-sway makes the yard feel inhabited between jobs.

jobs.title: Yard-tug hook idle dangle + tension quiver
jobs.rationale: Winch/hook/fairlead pivots exist; a hanging hook reads as a working tow rig.

jobs.title: Mining-drone idle coast + vane deploy
jobs.rationale: Drum pivot exists; add a sensor vane and a slow coast so drones feel alive between grinds.

jobs.title: Salvage-cutter jaw idle micro-chomp + ram brace
jobs.rationale: Jaw/ram pivots exist; idle chomp gives NPC scavengers visible appetite.

jobs.title: Cargo-pod drift wobble + door settle on jettison
jobs.rationale: Door/lock/retainer pivots exist; jettisoned pods should look like floating cargo, not statues.

jobs.title: Dock berth clamps + umbilical seat/release
jobs.rationale: The dock interior is the single most-viewed model; clamps meeting the hull is the game's handshake.

jobs.title: Drill-platform drill head spin + feed + stall
jobs.rationale: Nine drill:* events and the platform never moves; the drill IS the job.

jobs.title: Lane furniture life — beacon rotation + pulse
jobs.rationale: Buoys sit on every lane; slow rotating vanes turn dead props into working navigation hardware.

jobs.title: Ore-barge loading claw cycle
jobs.rationale: Working NPC miners/haulers do pure waypoint loops; a claw cycle sells the haul.

jobs.title: Freight-platform gantry load cycle
jobs.rationale: Freight stations are throughput set pieces; a moving gantry makes commerce visible.

jobs.title: Inspection-cutter boarding arm + scan array
jobs.rationale: Customs/interdiction moments are dramatic; the cutter should visibly reach for you.

jobs.title: Wasp telegraph brace + winglet deploy (patrol variants)
jobs.rationale: First enemy hull rig: telegraphs get a visible crouch so danger reads at a glance; covers every wasp variant pilot.

jobs.title: Survivor-pod eject tumble + beacon pulse
jobs.rationale: A rescue target should beg attention: tumble + strobing beacon, steadied on grab.

jobs.title: Interdiction-buoy petal unfold + snare spin-up
jobs.rationale: The moment you get snared should be theatrical — the buoy blooms before the grab.

jobs.title: Extraction-mast piston cycle on site machinery
jobs.rationale: Player-built site machinery is the claim payoff; a pumping mast makes a claim feel owned.

jobs.title: Shared engine-part nozzle gimbal (all hulls)
jobs.rationale: One part-rig articulates every hull that mounts it — the highest-leverage authored motion in the game.
jobs.integration: Requires authored-motion attach path on part-mounted instances (visualFactory), not just whole-model pilots.
